Returns that tell the truth

XIRR on every fund, SIP and portfolio

Absolute returns flatter SIPs and lump sums alike. Finance Tracker uses XIRR — the same annualised method fund houses use — so you can compare a 3-year SIP with a 6-month lump sum fairly.

  • SIP instalments recorded automatically at the right NAV
  • Per-fund and whole-portfolio XIRR
  • Realised and unrealised gains kept separate

FAQ

Questions, answered

Can’t find what you’re looking for?

support@mypgmanager.com
What can I track with Finance Tracker?

US stocks (NYSE/NASDAQ), Indian stocks (NSE), mutual funds and SIPs, interest-bearing loans you have given, real estate, other investments such as FDs or gold, cash balances and your monthly expenses — all rolled up into one net worth view.

Do I need to connect my bank or broker account?

No. You add transactions yourself or import them from Excel. Finance Tracker never asks for bank, broker or demat credentials.

Is Finance Tracker free?

Yes. Creating an account and tracking your stocks, mutual funds, property, loans and expenses is free on the web and on the Android app. There are no ads.

How are my returns calculated?

Mutual fund and portfolio returns use XIRR, which accounts for the timing of every purchase, SIP instalment and redemption — the same method fund houses use for annualised returns.

What is XIRR and why is it better than absolute return for SIPs?

XIRR is the annualised return of a series of cash flows made on different dates. Absolute return ignores time, so a SIP started last month and one started five years ago look alike. XIRR weighs each instalment by how long it was invested, so returns are comparable across funds and holding periods.

How are SIP instalments recorded?

Set up a SIP once with its amount and date. Each instalment is recorded automatically at that day’s NAV, using official NAV data published by AMFI, so units and XIRR stay up to date without manual entry.

Can I track investments for my family members?

Yes. Holdings can be kept in separate portfolios per family member or demat account, and the dashboard shows both each portfolio and the combined household net worth.

Can I track US and Indian investments together?

Yes. US holdings are valued in USD and converted at the current USD/INR rate so your combined net worth is shown in one currency.

Is my data private?

Your data is tied to your account and is not sold, shared or used for advertising. Passwords are stored only as bcrypt hashes and the site has no ad or analytics trackers.

Is there a mobile app?

Yes. Finance Tracker is available on Google Play for Android. Sign in with the same account and your data stays in sync with the website.

Can I export my data?

Yes. You can export your portfolio to Excel at any time and take a full JSON backup that can be restored later.
